WITH filtered_budget AS (
  SELECT 
    category,
    remaining,
    amount - spent AS amount_minus_spent
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount > 75
),
category_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    category,
    AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining,
    SUM(amount_minus_spent) AS total_spent_difference
  FROM filtered_budget
  GROUP BY category
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_spent_difference) AS avg_total
  FROM category_stats
)
SELECT 
  cs.category,
  cs.average_remaining,
  cs.total_spent_difference AS total,
  cs.total_spent_difference - oa.avg_total AS above_average
FROM category_stats cs
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE oa.avg_total IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.total_spent_difference > oa.avg_total;
